caption: The drawing depicts a single, goblet-shaped container with a lid, positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The container has a rounded base and a footed pedestal, both in a reddish-brown color. The main body of the container is light pink and is adorned with a horizontal row of green leaves and small yellow ovals, which resemble a decorative band. Above this band is another green decorative band encircling the container. The lid is also light pink with a green band and additional green and yellow decorative elements, and it is topped with a dark brown, knob-like handle. The drawing is realistic, and the vessel sits alone in the middle of the composition, with no other objects or background elements. There is a small printed text, "C.Herring," to the left of the container.
title: Pa. German Saffron Box
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
